summary: Quiet kerb beside a vacant gravel lot, bush opposite, no homes close.
reasons: Vacant lot and bush either side

best_section.where: West kerb of Rennies Road, beside the vacant gravel lot north of the office building

drivers.seclusion: West side backs onto a vacant gravel lot and a small grass verge; bush opposite. Nearest mapped buildings are commercial, 24 m or more away; the closest house sits across the road, well over 10 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Grass verge about 3 m wide beside the lane, with a footpath, gives room to pull off; two cars park on the east kerb.
drivers.traffic: Side street off Witton Road, light local traffic; arterial roar from the road to the east.
drivers.convention: Cars are parked on the opposite kerb, so a van will not stand out; the No Stopping sign is at the Witton Road end only.

flags: Low-lying: about 6 m elevation, Witton Creek 36 m away, flood-prone
Noise from the arterial to the east
No Stopping Any Time sign at the Witton Road end (0 m)
Check for a house across the road near 85 m
sun_shade: Open to the sun; tall bush to the east shades the morning and the building shades the south end.
cannot_judge: Whether the commercial neighbours use the lot at night
